title: How Well Can Vision-Language Models Understand Humans’ Intention? An Open-ended Theory of Mind Question Evaluation Benchmark
findings: All four tested models struggled to correctly identify religious attire, specifically misidentifying a cassock and stole as graduation robes, which led to incorrect inferences. However, GPT-based models were able to identify the intention of 'praying'.
